name: Garajonay National Park
description: Garajonay National Park blankets the misty heart of La Gomera, in Spain's Canary Islands. Roughly 70% of its 40 square kilometres is laurel forest, a moss-draped woodland fed by springs and streams that echoes the subtropical forests once common across southern Europe. Walkers can follow 18 footpaths past eroded volcanic rock towers, up to the island's 1,487-metre summit.
